prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1393; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the center with the left tail lamp housing broken and the trunk lid edge scuffed, all consistent with the reported parking lot impact. The damage pattern lines up well with the way the two vehicles met, and nothing suggests older or unrelated harm to this vehicle. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp assembly, refinishing the trunk lid edge, and recalibrating the parking sensors. Labor hours submitted fit the scope of this work. The invoices we reviewed show no repeated charges for the same operations. Recommend approval as submitted.
